Select target ChEMBL ID, target name, target type, protein accession, and protein sequence for all single-protein targets. Join target_dictionary to component_sequences via target_components. Filter by target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'. Return columns target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence. Sort by target_chembl_id, target_name, target_type, protein_accession, protein_sequence.
